page.layout: One column of running text; marginal notes in the right margin, in italic. Running head above the text, page number at top right, gathering signature below the last line.

main_text.p: Domine,& ex eodem liberalitatis fonte hau-rient,ex quo me aspergere dignatus es. At-que hic cogor nostrum stuporem incusare. Seipsum Dauid in exemplum proponit, nos docet,monet,incitat,et interim desides ster-timus. Quotus enim quisque est qui Dauidis exeplo in peccatis ingemiscat? qui lacrymas effundat ad Dei pedes prouolutus? qui ad di-uinam misericordiam confugiat? eam implo ret?ea nitatur? qui denique Deo supplicet in tot rebus aduersis quibus vndiq; premimur? Itaque non desunt exepla,sed desunt qui ex-Nō de- emplis propositis recte vti velint. Quinetiamsunt ex audire mihi videor vanā excusatione quamempla, multi suæ ignauiæ prætexunt: quid enim?in-sed qui quiunt,Sumus-ne cum Dauide comparandi?exēplis fas illi sane fuerit diuinam misericordia suisbene v- precibus euocare qui tot tantisque benefi-tantur. ciis ornatus, tot S.Spiritus donis illustratus fuit: nobis no item,qui ad Dauidis præstan-Iac.5. tiam nihil sumus.Itáne vero? At longè aliter concludit Iacobus: Elias, inquit, homo eratPreces iisdem quibus nos obnoxius, & precatus estnostra ne pluereť, atque adeò nō pluit super terramnon hu- annos tres & sex menses. Quid ergo sibi vultmanis Iacobus hoc exeplo proposito? num vt nosmeritis à precando deterreat cùm tam longè absi-fed fola mus ab Eliæ sanctitate? imò potius: Orate,Dei mi- inquit:falluntur enim qui preces ab hominūsericor- dignitate vel meritis pendere existimant,dia ni- cùm earum fructus à sola Dei misericordiātuntur?

page.notes: The text is one continuous paragraph carried over from the previous page, with no indented lines. Doubtful readings: "tuntur" in the last marginal note is faint and probably "nituntur", marked [?]. The gathering mark "f.j." is at the foot and was taken as the signature. The page number is printed as "8ɪ" and is given here as 81. Ligatures and long s are rendered as plain s; "tuntur." in the margin is set mid-column in a faded area. Printed forms "exeplo", "exepla", "exeplis", "vndiq;" and "ret?ea" are kept as printed.
